sections.introHtml: Teenagers today have a lot of things to do. They go to school, do homework, and spend time with friends. Some teenagers enjoy playing sports, while (1)______ like listening to music or using social media. Sometimes they feel tired when they have too much homework. (2) _______, it is important for them to relax. They can go for a walk, read books, or talk with their friends. These activities help them feel happier and (3) _______ than before. Parents should understand their children and give them advice. Teenagers also need love and care (4) _______ their families. Life can be easier when they have support from people around them. Teenage life is not always easy, but it is also (5) _______ and interesting.

sections.title: II. Read the following passage and do the tasks below(1.25pts)
sections.introHtml:
Many people enjoy living in a big city because they think life is more exciting there. However, I come from a small village and in my view, there are lots of benefits. The main reason I prefer village life is because it’s very quiet, so I always feel calm when I’m here. Another reason is that the air is so fresh and clean. We have more green spaces and bigger gardens, too. In addition, I think the people here are friendlier. Personally, I’m interested in wildlife photography, so the countryside is perfect for me.

The only downside is transport. I have an early start for a long journey to school in Faro and the school bus is always stopping to pick up more people. Also, it’s boring sometimes, but I enjoy chatting to my friends. Fortunately, I’m learning to ride a moped. On balance, I disagree that city life is better, as I think my village lifestyle is

healthier and more relaxing.

In spite of that, some of my friends couldn’t cope with life in the country, so it comes down to personal opinion.

People in the countryside are friendly to each other.

questions.referenceHtml:
1. Format: (0.1 point for correct format). One paragraph only with the introduction, the body,
and the conclusion.

2. Content: (0.4 point): a provision of main ideas and details as appropriate to the main idea.

3. Language: (0.3 point): a variety of vocabulary and structures appropriate to the level of
secondary students.

4. Presentation: (0.2 point): Coherence, cohesion and style appropriate to the level of secondary students.
